nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner stored in the Owned contract; guards privileged functions via the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address in the Owned contract, set by transferOwnership and consumed/reset by acceptOwnership.
Public ERC20 token symbol string, initialised to "MRIDUL" in the constructor.
Public ERC20 token name string, initialised to "MRIDUL" in the constructor.
Public number of token decimals, set to 0 in the constructor.
Total token supply; set to 1 in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => amount of approved allowance; mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Constructor of the Owned contract which assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner into newOwner for later acceptance.
Transfers ownership to newOwner after checking that the caller matches newOwner, then clears newOwner.
Constructor of the MRIDUL token which sets metadata, total supply and pre-allocates the whole supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance held by the zero address.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender in the allowed mapping and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from a source account to a destination using an existing allowance of msg.sender.
Returns the remaining allowance that tokenOwner has granted to spender.
Sets an allowance and then performs an external callback into spender's receiveApproval function.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject incoming ETH.
Owner-only rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 contract, sending tokens to the owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys, balance keys and event parameters.
Attacker-supplied external contract call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed with arbitrary calldata.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) into a user-supplied token contract.
Candidate new owner address written into the newOwner state variable.
Address whose balance is read from the balances mapping.
Recipient address of a transfer.
Number of tokens to move in transfer.
Address granted an allowance in the approve function.
Allowance amount written to the allowed mapping in approve.
Source account from which tokens are debited in transferFrom.
Destination account credited in transferFrom.
Token amount moved in transferFrom.
Owner address whose allowance entry is queried.
Spender address whose allowance entry is queried.
Address that receives the allowance and is called back by approveAndCall.
Allowance amount set before the external callback.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
Arbitrary ERC20 contract address provided by the owner for the rescue call.
Token amount transferred out through the rescue function.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable inside the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor writes the deployer address into the owner state variable.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable in transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the candidate owner into newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership state changes.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate and to promote it to owner.
acceptOwnership assigns newOwner to the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets the newOwner state variable to address(0).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner, restricting who may complete the ownership handover.
MRIDUL constructor writes the symbol state variable.
MRIDUL constructor writes the name state variable.
MRIDUL constructor writes the decimals state variable.
MRIDUL constructor sets the total supply to 1.
MRIDUL constructor pre-allocates the whole supply in the balances mapping for a fixed address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply to compute the reported supply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Parameter to is used as the recipient key when crediting balances in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount debited from msg.sender and credited to the recipient.
msg.sender is the source account of the transfer and an argument to the Transfer event.
transfer updates the balances mapping for the sender and the recipient.
Parameter spender is the second key of the allowed mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value written in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve and an argument to the Approval event.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
Parameter from is the account debited in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the account credited in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender key on the allowed mapping in transferFrom.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping of the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance entry.
Parameter tokenOwner is the outer key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender is the inner key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
Parameter spender is both the allowance key and the callback target in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is written to the allowance and forwarded to the callback.
Parameter data is forwarded as calldata to the external receiveApproval callback.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and the from argument of the external callback.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into spender-controlled code that can re-enter the token.
The untrusted receiveApproval callback executes after the allowed mapping is updated, enabling reentrant abuse of allowance state.
Parameter tokenAddress determines which contract is called in transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is the amount requested from the external token contract.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferAnyERC20Token to msg.sender equal to owner.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the owner state variable as the recipient of the external transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary, potentially malicious token contract.
The external transfer call targets the owner address held in storage.
